bounds: One notification group, three allocated row IDs, wall clock 0 through 2, one queued write, two non-silent inputs and representative silent, permanent, explicit-expiry and count-override inputs.
fairness: RequestFinishes assumes weak fairness of the serial writer's successful settlement. An admitted write can wait forever without fairness.
limitations: This case projects a row to its identity, title, silent priority, expiration, count and read mark. Exact projection uses the approval owner's unread, permanent, no-coalesced-count predicate.
Time advances monotonically within the finite clock. A default silent lifetime is one model tick. The real suite checks the 24-hour value and explicit timestamps and null.
Write failure and ambiguous persistence are in NotificationDurability. Tenant ownership, cross-process writers, mixed group histories and arbitrary callbacks are outside this case.

assumptions: No fairness. A change in visibility leaves the retained row until a later write.
